beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, there's a song so catchy that if you hear one second of it, you dance for as long as it's playing.
beats.visual: Dawn on main street. Thirty townspeople dance in perfect sync with sweaty, sleepy faces. In the middle the narrator (my avatar with headphones) stands still, arms crossed, deadpan.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: It started at the town fair, when DJ Noodle played a mystery track.
beats.visual: Flashback, day, town square. The stage banner reads 'TOWN FAIR'. DJ Noodle (sunglasses, gold chain, yellow cap) stands behind a glowing DJ booth with two spinning turntables.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: It only had four words.
beats.visual: Close-up of DJ Noodle's smug face as he slowly presses a big red button on the booth.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Bimbalo! Fezza-ree! Oonga vay! Dooblanni!
beats.visual: Giant stamped words slam across the screen one at a time over pulsing purple fair lights. A small note at the bottom says 'DON'T SING THIS'.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: The whole fair crowd snaps into dance2 at once. Party night lighting kicks in, camera shake on each HUSS.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Now we have rules. Always wear headphones. Never hum. And never look a dancer in the eyes.
beats.overlay: RULE 1: HEADPHONES. RULE 2: NO HUMMING. RULE 3: NO EYE CONTACT.
beats.visual: Main street, day. Three rule cards pop in one by one: a kid in giant headphones, a crossed-out humming face, a kid covering his eyes as he walks past a dancer.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Mrs. Pell hummed it in the bakery. Twelve customers danced out the door.
beats.visual: Main street bakery. Mrs. Pell (apron, hair bun, glasses) hums with her eyes closed. A conga line of twelve customers dances out of the door and down the street.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Officer Brandt sneezed it. The whole police station did the worm.
beats.visual: Officer Brandt (blue cap, mustache) sneezes. Cut to three officers lying flat (crowdSurf pose) in a row on the street, wiggling the worm in sync.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Me? I never take my headphones off. Not even in the shower.
beats.visual: Kid's bedroom. The narrator sleeps in bed with headphones on. Gag cut: he wears a shower cap over the headphones and holds a rubber duck, smug face.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Until yesterday, when someone in a hood, with glowing green eyes, hacked the clock tower speakers.
beats.visual: Night: a hooded figure with two glowing green eyes crouches at the clock tower speakers and plugs in a cable. HACKED stamps over it.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The whole town started dancing. Grandma. The mailman. Even the pigeon.
beats.visual: Party night. The speakers blast glowing music notes over town. Quick cuts: Grandma starts dancing, the mailman (blue cap, sash bag) starts dance2, the pigeon bobs its head in time.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: They danced all night... while they're out partying, by the way.
beats.overlay: WHILE THEY'RE OUT PARTYING, BY THE WAY
beats.visual: Party night montage: a conga line around the clock tower and a crowd-surfer in the square. The narrator sits alone on the park picnic table with headphones on, deadpan.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Rapid cuts of dancers' huss faces under pink and purple strobe lights, camera shake on every HUSS.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then my headphones beeped. Battery: five percent.
beats.visual: Close-up on the narrator's headphones flashing red as a battery icon appears. His face turns to sweat.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Four. Three. The song leaked in. My foot started tapping. Ah, almost... almost!
beats.visual: The battery counter drops 4%, then 3%, and the muffled music gets louder. The narrator's foot starts tapping and he catches himself with a jolt (stunned pose).

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I had to reach the clock tower. But the streets were jammed.
beats.visual: Wide shot from the narrator's view: the glowing clock tower far away past a main street packed wall to wall with dancers.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then it hit me. If they have to dance... they can dance me there.
beats.visual: The narrator in the think pose, then a sly grin as a lightbulb pops above his head.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I squeezed my eyes shut, because you never look a dancer in the eyes, and dove into the crowd. Goon Squad!
beats.visual: The narrator leaps backward off the picnic table into the crowd, arms out. The dancers snap to attention in sunglasses and catch him.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The whole town passed me over their heads, right to the clock tower.
beats.visual: The narrator in the crowdSurf pose glides over a sea of dancing townspeople down main street toward the glowing clock tower, camera tracking alongside.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I climbed the ladder. One percent left. I yanked the plug.
beats.visual: The narrator climbs a ladder up the clock tower with the battery icon blinking red. He grabs a giant glowing power plug and yanks it out in a burst of sparks.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Total silence, then three slow-motion HUSS cuts of the narrator on top of the clock tower holding the plug up in the moonlight, huss face.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Everyone flopped like noodles. Then they cheered. Top ten respect.
beats.overlay: TOP 10 RESPECTFUL MOMENTS: #1 THE TOWN CARRIED ME
beats.visual: The whole town collapses flat on the ground, then jumps up cheering and clapping at the narrator. A Top 10 card slides in.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then the sky turned purple. A giant spaceship came down, blasting the remix. And in every window, glowing green eyes.
beats.visual: Purple sky: a huge round blocky spaceship lowers over the clock tower, rings of speakers pumping; every porthole glows with pairs of green eyes (the same as the hacker's).

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: And my battery? Zero percent.
beats.visual: Close-up: the narrator's headphones go dark and the battery icon hits 0%. His foot taps, his shocked face fights it, and he breaks into a reluctant dance. Cut to black.
